skills.name: sailsjs-api

skills.name: debug-reactjs-error

Use it even when the user only pastes an error or says "my component is not working" without mentioning debugging. For bugs that span React and the API, use debug-mern-stack-error instead.

skills.name: debug-expressjs-error

Use it even when the user only pastes a stack trace. For issues that span React and Express, use debug-mern-stack-error instead.

skills.name: debug-mern-stack-error

Use it when the symptom appears in the browser but the cause might be on either side. For a bug clearly confined to one layer use debug-reactjs-error or debug-expressjs-error.

skills.name: debug-sailsjs-error
